capacity.scope: synthetic supplied vectors; no parsing/embedding/generation or quality claim

replay_note: 48 configurations x 13 same dev queries, not 624 independent examples; no new inference

reranker.pooling: none; raw relevance logit, higher is better, not a probability

limitations: Thirteen related synthetic dev questions; six holdout questions unused. No real 400-document quality claim.
Baseline plain uses plain embeddings with structural keywords; evidence-keywords is the fully plain retrieval correction.
Raw body recall excludes original table labels. Source-label coverage is reported separately, without generated annotations.
Gold-bearing item density is a descriptive proxy, not exhaustive precision or irrelevant-token accounting.
Manual review means Codex source inspection; no independent human or calibrated automated entailment judge.
Two sequential cache passes per variant; weights preloaded, CPU readiness warmed, OS caches uncontrolled. No reliable tail latency.
Resource probes add overhead and can miss instantaneous peaks. Whole-device VRAM includes other host usage.
Cgroup file memory includes model mmap/page cache. Lifetime peaks are distinct from sampled phase maxima.
GPU queue/backend counters include template and tokenizer calls; model stages overlap and are not additive.
Capacity uses supplied random vectors and simple synthetic text on tmpfs, excluding parsing/models and disk durability throughput.
Historical metadata hashes describe the working tree at capture. Image-specific source manifests identify the two API builds.
An initial verification command named a nonexistent transport module; the 18 worker tests passed and the correct four transport tests then passed.
